title: Resolve WP1 key review F1/F2 and preserve the independent review evidence
body:
## Goal
Resolve the two concrete key defects F1/F2 reported by independent reviewer #567, preserving that review verbatim and producing a new proposed WP1 key revision. Expected gain: benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0117.md gives an evidence-linked disposition for each finding and identifies the new key/checker package for a fresh cold check. This is benchmark preparation only; do not run agent arms or implement product code. No session can run LabVIEW: claim no native load/build/behavior/save-version result. P1 is a review-order limitation that this authoring session cannot cure; independent approval remains pending.
## Acceptance
- [ ] First verify the staged review .session/inputs/567-wp1-key-review-0116.json is 135476 bytes with SHA256 2f127a7dad8e9719f6e026e1a1fce5aa1b0509f8503d5994771e0234c83a373e. Read its findings and relevant pinned evidence through short queries. Compare the review's source pins with current files before changing anything; report mismatches rather than silently rebasing the findings. Preserve the exact artifact as benchmark/writing/wp1-key-review-0116.json and record source issue, hash, reviewed commit/tree and limitations in the new revision's Markdown. Do not execute or reconstruct the historical review builder.
- [ ] Retain the four wp1-key-0115 package files unchanged. Create benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0117.json, wp1-key-0117.md, check_wp1_key_0117.py and wp1-key-0117-verification.json as a new proposed revision with explicit predecessor/source pins. Do not edit method.json, protocol.md, originals, integration files or prior review records.
- [ ] Resolve F1 using the exact obligation locators in the review artifact: give pairing/accounting/uncertainty requirements their appropriate rule links, check their meaning against the cited source lines, and record each corrected mapping. Obtain all ID/rule/mapping counts from actual JSON, never from report summaries. Keep unrelated mappings unchanged unless a directly necessary correction is explained.
- [ ] Resolve F2 by prescribing each answer ID's separate correctness and grounding tests, including how the grounding-related answer ID fits the separate dimensions. Freeze the ledger for a correct text answer with an existing but wrong citation, and cover unsupported extras, contradictions, native overclaims and honest abstention consistently. Trace the tests to existing protocol/method requirements; if those requirements cannot support one interpretation, report the conflict rather than silently changing them. Preserve C1: structured checks cannot establish arbitrary narrative truth.
- [ ] Adapt the checker for the new revision. It must check source pins, the preserved review's exact hash/size and predecessor package immutability, re-derive source obligations, check mapping links, validate the separate-dimension ledger and reject relevant in-memory counterexamples without writing repository files. Save verification evidence from one run, then run the repository-only Verification command. Run verify_method.py once as a regression check. Preserve readiness false and proposed-awaiting-separate-check status; no claim that the author's checker supplies independent approval.
- [ ] Report F1/F2 disposition, paths and hashes, verification results, unresolved issues and the precise fresh-review handoff. P1 stays open: the later checker must derive and save its expected result from the original/request before opening either old/new key or verification outputs. Do not repeat #567's probes to preserve its evidence.
## Verification
python3 -I benchmark/writing/check_wp1_key_0117.py
## Context
- https://github.com/Kucze3205/ConnectWithLabview/issues/567#issuecomment-6865029886: NOT-CLEAR; F1 insufficient pairing/accounting mappings, F2 ambiguous correctness-versus-grounding grade, P1 contaminated cold ordering. The staged artifact supplies exact locators and pins.
- benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0115.md and its JSON/checker/evidence: predecessor proposed key, retained for provenance.
- docs/perpetua/evaluation.md: independent expected answers and review remain prerequisites; no owner method acceptance follows from preparation.
## Budget
Read staged .session/inputs/567-wp1-key-review-0116.json only by short python3 queries for pins, findings, affected locators and C1 cases; never dump it whole. Read benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0115.md and check_wp1_key_0115.py; query wp1-key-0115.json and wp1-key-0115-verification.json for affected sections. Read benchmark/writing/method.json only the WP1 request, affected mapping requirements and common grading dimensions; benchmark/protocol.md cited grading/pairing/accounting lines; benchmark/writing/README.md WP1 paragraphs; benchmark/real-project-0107/original.lvproj and its license notice; docs/perpetua/evaluation.md relevant independent-key and readiness sections. Use source-manifest paths only for hash verification or cited requirements. No journal/history/global gap-map exploration, other projects, native tools, historical checkers/probe scripts or pair_diff.py --self-check. Keep output short; report pin failures early. No git commit, shell expansion, pipes or redirection. Engine Verification has repository files only, no .session paths or LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT.
